course.description: What puts the failure right. fix: a change the run makes - the items say what, and each is built, tested, reviewed and folded before the step runs again. retry: nothing to change - what failed was passing (a service that was down, a lock another run held, a limit that has lifted), and the step runs again as it is. person: only a person can lift what stands in the way - a decision, an access, a tool to install, a check to run again; the person is asked, with the choices.

summary.description: What failed and what puts it right, in a few sentences a person who was not there can follow; it is shown to the person where one is asked, and goes into the commits of the remedy.

cause.description: The cause the evidence shows: the first thing that went wrong, and why; or "not found", where you could not find it.

evidence.description: What shows the cause, each read or run in this task and quoted as printed: a line of the output, a file and line, a command you ran and what it printed.

items.description: Where the course is fix, the work items that put the failure right, at least one and at most 4; empty otherwise. Each is shaped as a plan's item and sized to one builder's cycle.

name.description: A short name for the item: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

title.description: One line that says what the item delivers; it becomes the subject of the item's commit.

instructions.description: Everything the agent that builds the item needs: what to build, where, what must hold when it is done, and what is out of its scope.

done.description: The remedy's definition of done: what must hold once the failure is put right, as statements a person or a check can answer one by one - above all that the step that failed would now pass, and the test that shows it. The builder works to it and the review weighs it.

ownedPaths.description: The path patterns this item may write. No file is matched by the patterns of two items.

forbiddenPaths.description: Path patterns this item must not touch, though they are near its work.

reuses.description: The existing code this item reuses or extends. Empty only where the repository has no machinery related to what the item needs.

path.description: The existing code the item builds on: a file or a directory in the repository.

what.description: What is there, and what the item uses or extends it for.

creates.description: What this item creates from nothing. Empty where everything it does extends what exists.

what.description: The new thing: a type, a service, a helper, a file.

why.description: Why nothing that exists serves, or can be extended to serve.

searched.description: What was searched for, and where, before it was decided that this has to be new.

replaces.description: Existing code this item refactors, rewrites or creates again because the request itself asked for that. Empty where the request asked for none; nothing else that exists is rebuilt.

path.description: The existing code the item rebuilds: a file or a directory in the repository.

what.description: What is rebuilt, and what becomes of the old one: rewritten in place, or removed by this item.

testFilter.description: The filter that names the tests this item's change affects - the test classes that test what it changes, the tests it writes among them; for a runner that selects tests by name, their names - written in what each leg's test runner takes after its filter option, as the task lists them; it names only tests that are there or that the item writes. The engine tests the item on it alone where the run's input affectedTests is on, and every test runs once every item of the round is built. Empty is no filter: every test of each leg runs.

choices.description: Where the course is person, the choices the person has, at least two, each saying what it leads to; empty otherwise. Recommend none: the run's advisor recommends, by the repository's bar.

choice.description: What the person would do or decide, in one sentence.

leadsTo.description: What follows from it for the run and for the work.

preExisting.description: Issues you met that were there before this run - outside what it changed - each reported and never fixed by you. Empty where you met none.

title.description: One line: what is wrong, and where.

description.description: What is wrong and what it causes, as you saw it.

where.description: The paths, from the repository's root, or the command.

evidence.description: What you read or ran and saw, quoted: the file and its lines, or the command and what it printed.

blocks.description: True only where it stops your own work.
